# Septim Labs

> Septim Labs is a small software studio that ships two things: (1) Claude Code tools for indie founders ($9–$149, paid once, owned forever, no subscription), and (2) custom software builds for small businesses (fixed price, $2,500–$30,000, $0/month hosting available). Solo-operator owned. Built and run by a small team that answers email directly.

## Audience

- **Semi-techy indie builders** — designers who learned React, marketers who learned to code, AI-curious solopreneurs. Buy boilerplates, kits, and Claude Code tools $9–$149.
- **Claude Code practitioners** — mid-level developers (NOT senior engineers) overwhelmed by Claude Code setup. Buy Agents Pack, Drills, Prompts Pack.
- **AI-curious agency / small-business owners** — non-developers who want "AI for my business" but need plain-English help. Buy Audit ($99 founding), Session ($149), Deploy ($499), or commission custom builds.

## Pricing

- Free tools: 22-tool Forge suite (forge.septimlabs.com), MCP Security Checklist, /find product-recommender quiz.
- Paid kits ($9–$49): Starter ($9), Prompts Pack ($9), Kinsman ($19), Ship Pack ($19), Flint ($19), Drills ($29), Landing Kit ($29), Dunner ($49), Agents Pack ($49).
- Bundles ($69–$169): Claude Code Mastery Bundle ($69), Product Kit ($99), Founder Bundle ($129), Ultimate Bundle ($149), Founder Deluxe ($169).
- Services ($99–$499): Audit ($99 founding rate / $499 standard), Session 90-min ($149), Sift async ($199), Rescue 24/7 ($299), Deploy ($499).
- Custom builds: $2,500 (starter sites) – $30,000 (full SaaS platforms). Always fixed price.
- Active coupon: `FOUNDINGRATE24` — 20% off the 6 solo kits (Prompts, Ship, Landing, Drills, Flint, Agents Pack). 50 use cap. 48-hour rotating window.

## Core products

- [Septim Agents Pack](https://septimlabs.com/agents): Your Claude has a lawyer, a designer, and a CFO. 10 specialist personas drop into Claude Code — Atlas (chief of staff), Luca (CTO), Canon (brand), Ember (CMO), Tally (CFO), Nova (design), Ward (legal), Mira (customer), Juno (research), Pip (intern). $49 lifetime, GitHub repo invite on purchase.
- [Septim Drills](https://septimlabs.com/drills): 25 ready-made instructions that make Claude stop winging it. Drop into ~/.claude/skills/. Covers PR review, test gaps, migration safety, security triage, changelog, launch copy, and 19 more. $29 lifetime.
- [Septim Flint](https://septimlabs.com/flint): Claude reviews every code change automatically. 5 GitHub Actions workflows; self-hosted on your runners; uses your Anthropic API key. $19 lifetime. Existing Drills owners get Flint free.
- [Septim Prompts Pack](https://septimlabs.com/prompts): 24 portable prompts for solo founders. Scope, design, engineering, legal, launch — every one used on a real Septim Labs launch. Stateless. Works in Claude.ai, Claude Code, ChatGPT. $9 lifetime.
- [Septim Landing Kit](https://septimlabs.com/landing): 10 plain-HTML landing page templates from real Septim products. No framework, no JavaScript bloat. Edit one CSS variable, ship. $29 lifetime.
- [Septim Ship Pack](https://septimlabs.com/ship): 15 launch-post templates for Show HN, r/SideProject, X threads, LinkedIn, IndieHackers, cold email, founder DMs. Battle-tested. $19 lifetime.
- [Septim Product Kit](https://septimlabs.com/kit): Production-ready Next.js + Supabase + Stripe scaffold. Skip 4 weekends of plumbing, ship in 1. $99 lifetime, GitHub repo.
- [Septim Starter](https://septimlabs.com/septim-starter): Brand-new to Claude Code? 3 sub-agents (Atlas, Luca, Pip), a CLAUDE.md template, a /review skill. $9 lifetime.
- [Septim Kinsman](https://septimlabs.com/septim-kinsman): Custom Tailwind preset + claude-design-override.css. Break the default Claude-generated app look. $19 lifetime.
- [Septim Dunner](https://septimlabs.com/septim-dunner): 3 dunning emails, Stripe webhook retry blueprint, recovery tracker. One recovered failed payment pays for it. $49 lifetime.
- [Septim Vault](https://septimlabs.com/vault): Encrypted-locally credential vault for solo developers. Stop storing API keys in a sticky note. $29 lifetime.
- [Septim Tether](https://septimlabs.com/tether): Pre-commit hooks (catch bad code before it ships). Framework-aware. $19 lifetime.
- [Septim Review Stack](https://septimlabs.com/review-stack): Drills + Flint + Tether bundled. $59, save $18 vs. separate.

## Bundles

- [Septim Claude Code Mastery Bundle](https://septimlabs.com/claude-bundle): Drills + Agents Pack + Prompts Pack. The complete Claude upgrade in one payment. $69 lifetime, three private repos. Saves $18 vs. separate.
- [Septim Founder Bundle](https://septimlabs.com/bundle): Product Kit + Agents Pack. Two private repos. The starter set every solo founder should own. $129 lifetime.
- [Septim Ultimate Bundle](https://septimlabs.com/ultimate): Product Kit + Agents Pack + Ship Pack. Three private repos. $149 lifetime, save $18.
- [Septim Founder Deluxe](https://septimlabs.com/deluxe): Five private repos. Everything but Forge. The complete operator's suite. $169 lifetime, save $36.

## Services

- [Septim Audit](https://septimlabs.com/audit): Ten-agent teardown of your SaaS product. PDF + loom verdict in 48 hours. $99 founding rate (first 10 slots) / $499 standard. Refund if the PDF doesn't surface 5+ specific fixes.
- [Septim Session](https://septimlabs.com/septim-session): 90-minute live Zoom that rebuilds your Claude Code setup with you watching. CLAUDE.md, agents, skills, hooks. You keep everything. $149 flat.
- [Septim Sift](https://septimlabs.com/septim-sift): Async written code-review. Send one repo + one question, get a 400–700 word verdict in 24 hours. $199 flat.
- [Septim Rescue](https://septimlabs.com/septim-rescue): Emergency intervention when your Claude bill is spiking RIGHT NOW. 2-hour first-response, 9am–midnight ET, 7 days a week. $299 per incident.
- [Septim Deploy](https://septimlabs.com/septim-deploy): Hands-on deploy session. We ship together. You keep credentials, the deploy, and the running app. $499 flat.

## Free resources

- [Septim Forge](https://forge.septimlabs.com): 22 free client-side developer tools — JSON formatter, Base64 encoder, JWT decoder, regex tester, hash generator, UUID generator, color converter, and more. No signup, no tracking, browser-only. $9 Forge Pro unlocks 6 advanced tools.
- [MCP Security Checklist](https://septimlabs.com/tools/mcp-security-checklist): 12-point self-audit for any MCP server. Covers the April 2026 STDIO RCE class of vulnerabilities. 15 minutes, free, no email required.
- [Find your Septim](https://septimlabs.com/find): 30-second quiz that recommends one Septim product based on your situation.

## Custom builds

- Custom CRMs, SaaS platforms, internal tools, agency-grade builds. Examples in our portfolio: 6-bay auto-detail CRM (Lingenfelter), dental patient portal (Meridian), property management console (Atlas), taproom POS (Fireside), fitness member-ops platform (Summit). Same modern stack as agencies charging $50K+ (Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, Stripe, Supabase). Fixed-price, $0/month hosting available, 60-day satisfaction guarantee, 100% code ownership.
